ORAL ORDER

This Court, on 18.06.2024 had passed a peremptory order, which reads as follows:
"Two weeks time is granted to comply with the office objections, failing which,
petition would be dismissed without reference to the Bench.
In the event, the office objections are complied with, list the matter before the Court at the appropriate stage without a memo."
Even today, the learned counsel for petitioners has not complied with the office objections.
Therefore, the petition is dismissed for its non-prosecution.

Sd/-
(M.NAGAPRASANNA) JUDGE KG Lingappa.
